content:
G'day fellow Australian,
Nice puzzle. I do think it would be better to provide a brief description of the task rather than a link to wikipedia. The link could still be included alongside a description. For your list of examples, it could be reduced to 4 phrases, 1 for each of length 2 and 3 and separators ' ' and '-'.

Input
 - Change to: <<1 Line:>> A string of {{2}} or {{3}} words, separated by spaces or {{-}}.

Output
 - Change to: <<1 Line:>> The string after sorting the words, with the same separator as the input string.

Constraints
 - Change line 2 to "Input is always either {{2}} or {{3}} words."
 - Change line 3 to "Each word will only contain one vowel, and that vowel will be {{a}}, {{i}} or {{o}}." and just don't include bing bang boom unless you can think of other phrases that are similar.

Cases
 - More space separated case pairs would be good
 - More 3 word long case pairs would be good. I'm thinking 1 where the output is the input reversed, 2 or 3 where 2 words are swapped, 1 where no change is made.
